title: Identification of BMX as a Potential Biomarker for Rheumatoid Arthritis Based on WGCNA, Machine Learning, and Experimental Validation.
authors: Huang, Xinmin; Cai, Xu; Yan, Zhenbo; Wu, Xian; Chen, Xinpeng; Xiao, Jianwei
one_liner_zh: 该文基于WGCNA和机器学习筛选类风湿关节炎生物标志物BMX，仅涉及基因表达与临床相关性，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic autoimmune disease needing reliable biomarkers. This study aimed to identify potential RA biomarkers using WGCNA and machine learning, and analyze their correlation with disease activity and STAT3. METHODS: GEO datasets were used. WGCNA and three machine learning methods (LASSO, SVM, Boruta) screened common core genes. Correlation with STAT3 was analyzed. RT-qPCR validated core gene expression in RA patients. Correlation with clinical parameters (DAS28, CCP, RF, ESR) and ROC curves were assessed. RESULTS: WGCNA identified 11 modules; the black module correlated most with RA. LASSO, SVM, and Boruta identified 16, 35, and 46 key genes respectively, with one overlapping core gene: BMX. BMX expression positively correlated with STAT3. RT-qPCR confirmed BMX upregulation in RA, which positively correlated with DAS28 and RF. ROC analysis gave an AUC of 0.789. CONCLUSION: BMX expression is upregulated in RA patients, correlates with disease activity, and represents a potential diagnostic biomarker. The BMX‑STAT3 correlation suggests its possible involvement in RA pathogenesis, but the regulatory relationship requires further functional validation.
abstract_zh: 背景：类风湿关节炎（rheumatoid arthritis, RA）是一种慢性自身免疫性疾病，需要可靠的生物标志物。本研究旨在利用WGCNA和机器学习识别潜在的RA生物标志物，并分析其与疾病活动度和STAT3的相关性。方法：使用GEO数据集。通过WGCNA和三种机器学习方法（LASSO、SVM、Boruta）筛选共同核心基因。分析其与STAT3的相关性。采用RT-qPCR验证RA患者中核心基因的表达。评估与临床参数（DAS28、CCP、RF、ESR）的相关性及ROC曲线。结果：WGCNA识别出11个模块；其中黑色模块与RA相关性最强。LASSO、SVM和Boruta分别识别出16、35和46个关键基因，其中有一个重叠核心基因：BMX。BMX表达与STAT3呈正相关。RT-qPCR证实RA中BMX表达上调，且与DAS28和RF呈正相关。ROC分析得出AUC为0.789。结论：BMX在RA患者中表达上调，与疾病活动度相关，并代表一种潜在的诊断生物标志物。BMX-STAT3相关性提示其可能参与RA发病机制，但调控关系需进一步功能验证。
